easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.name: Springheart Nantuko
uses.cardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
